thread:
Sam: Kicking off Hearthbridge Medical onboarding. Goal: pilot 2 clinics in 60 days, full rollout in 120. Need to align owners, success criteria, and go/no-go gates. Main risks: data residency, SSO cert, and clinician training.
Maya: I'm the Hearthbridge PM (Maya Lin). Internal owners: Tony (IT), Priya (Clinical Ops), Omar (Security). Data must stay in us-east-1 per contract.
Sam: Thanks. High-level timeline: Week 1-2: connectivity + sample data; Week 3-4: mapping + validation; Week 5-8: pilot; Week 9-12: iterate + scale. Go/no-go at end of Week 4 (mapping pass).
Devon: SE note  we'll need a sample dataset and sample PHI masking rules. If mapping is complex, recommend an incremental ingest with feature flags.
Iris: I'll own enablement + clinician training. Proposed: 2 hrs training per clinic, recorded session, quick-reference PDF. Scheduling: pilot training week of 2026-05-11.
Nikhil: Infra/security check  SSO certs + SCIM provisioning. Security review ETA 10 business days after docs received. Also need SOC2 report access.
Sam: Success criteria (proposed): pilot clinicians complete tasks in <2 minutes median; data sync error rate <0.5%; platform availability 99.9% during pilot; 75% clinician task adoption by end of pilot. Renewal risk triggers: <50% adoption or >2 incidents/week.
Maya: We'll collect feedback via weekly 10-min interviews + short in-app survey. I'll send list of pilot clinicians by EOD.
Devon: Integration ask: send sample payload and auth headers. Sample curl for ingest test (dev only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"patient_id":"hb-001","note":"patient reported chest pain","ts":"2026-05-01T09:10:00Z"}'
```
Iris: Nice. I'll slot training sessions and will produce a 1-page checklist for clinicians.
Nikhil: We also want encryption-at-rest verification. Maya, can your legal team share the data residency clause?
Maya: On it. Sending contract excerpt to this thread shortly.
Sam: Action items recap: 1) Maya to provide pilot clinician roster + data residency clause (due 2026-05-03). 2) Devon to send sample payload + integration doc (due 2026-04-30). 3) Nikhil to start SSO/security intake once docs arrive (ETA 10bd). 4) Iris to prep training materials (draft due 2026-05-07). 5) Sam to publish kickoff playbook and schedule weekly ops check-ins.
Sam: @OnboardBot create task "HB pilot dataset + mapping" assign: Maya, Devon due: 2026-05-04.
OnboardBot: Task created: "HB pilot dataset + mapping" assigned to Maya, Devon. Due 2026-05-04.
Maya: Quick ask  can Redwood host a short demo for clinicians before pilot? 30 min.
Sam: Yes, we can. Tentative demo: 2026-05-10 16:00 ET. Iris please confirm availability.
Iris: Confirmed. I'll send calendar invites and Zoom link.
Devon: One more technical risk note  if inbound notes exceed 8KB we'll chunk them. I'll add chunking guideline to the integration doc.
Sam: Good call. We'll bake that into success criteria (no payload loss).
Maya: For feedback capture, we'll run a weekly NPS pulse and a 3-question post-task survey in-app. I'll share survey drafts by Mon.
Sam: Next checkpoint: weekly ops call starting 2026-05-05 09:00 PT. If mapping issues delay go/no-go, we may slide pilot by 1-2 weeks.
Nikhil: FYI security will request a short attestation checklist. I'll post that here after initial review.
Iris: I'll also prepare a clinician escalation flow and include the on-call engineer contact.
Sam: Thanks everyone. I'll drop the kickoff doc link to this thread in a few minutes and set up the recurring meeting. :rocket:
